systems.system: Guichet Unique de facilitation de la délivrance des actes administratifs relatifs à l'utilisation du sol et à la construction
systems.owner: Each Communauté Urbaine, with the state services involved in the procedure
systems.tiers: Instituted at each Communauté Urbaine; includes a platform for the dematerialised handling of land-use and building permits, with online filing

note: A 2018 prime ministerial decree instituting one-stop shops for land-use and building permits at the Communautés Urbaines (Articles 1-5 captured): a legal instrument creating a permit platform, with no statement that any is operating or of how any office is connected; a law places nothing.
